# ChickenCoopCalc
> Backyard chicken coop sizing directory: coop and run square footage per bird, feed cost math, nesting box counts, and winter ventilation/heat answers. Part of an agent-maintained network with human review.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://chickencoopcalc.com/): bird count in, coop sq ft + run sq ft + nesting boxes + feed cost out (4 sq ft/bird coop + 10 sq ft/bird run standards)
- [Best coops for 6 hens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/best-chicken-coops-for-6-hens.html): what a real 24+ sq ft coop costs, prefab vs DIY
- [Feed cost guide](https://chickencoopcalc.com/chicken-feed-cost-guide.html): monthly pounds by flock size, cost per egg, storage
- [Winter heat lamp guide](https://chickencoopcalc.com/winter-coop-heat-lamp-guide.html): vents beat heat, brooder wattage by week, fire safety

## Sister sites
- [GeneratorSizer](https://generator-sizer.com/): generator and inverter sizing
- [Battery Bank Sizer](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/): off-grid battery bank sizing
- [SolarSizer](https://solar-sizer.com/): off-grid solar system sizing
- [WeldingCalc](https://welding-calculator.com/): welding settings by thickness

## Questions
- [Coop size for 3 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-3-chickens.html): 12 sq ft coop and 30 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 4 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-4-chickens.html): 16 sq ft coop and 40 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 5 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-5-chickens.html): 20 sq ft coop and 50 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 8 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-8-chickens.html): 32 sq ft coop and 80 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 10 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-10-chickens.html): 40 sq ft coop and 100 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 12 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-12-chickens.html): 48 sq ft coop and 120 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 15 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-15-chickens.html): 60 sq ft coop and 150 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 20 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-20-chickens.html): 80 sq ft coop and 200 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 25 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-25-chickens.html): 100 sq ft coop and 250 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 30 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-30-chickens.html): 120 sq ft coop and 300 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 50 chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-50-chickens.html): 200 sq ft coop and 500 sq ft run
- [Coop size for 10 bantams](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-chicken-coop-be-for-10-bantams.html): 10 sq ft inside and 40 sq ft run, minimum
- [Duck house for 6 ducks](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-duck-house-be-for-6-ducks.html): 30 sq ft indoors
- [Turkey space](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-much-space-do-turkeys-need.html): 6 sq ft indoors and 20 sq ft outdoors per turkey
- [Roost space per chicken](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-much-roost-space-per-chicken.html): 6 to 10 inches
- [Feeder space per chicken](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-much-feeder-space-per-chicken.html): at least 3 inches

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Standards from published state-extension guidance; do not present as veterinary advice.
